summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K (press release) reporting Q2 2026 results and raising full-year guidance. The CEO disclosed that the company received unsolicited preliminary expressions of interest from multiple parties to take the company private and that the Board formed a special committee of independent directors to oversee potential discussions. No specific price, premium, or deal structure was provided. The transaction is exploratory with no guarantee of outcome. This constitutes a nascent strategic review process. Watch for further disclosures on special committee progress and any formal bid.
